title: Eleanor Roosevelt letter to Oppenheimer

tellings.quote: the rumors of UFOs at Los Alamos and other nuclear sites were so widespread that Elanor Roosevelt wrote to Oppenheimer inquiring about them responding with a letter that's been fully verified and archived in the Library of Congress Oppenheimer wrote back reassuring the former first lady that these were just rumors

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in the late 1940s and 1950s rumours of UFOs at Los Alamos, the New Mexico lab where the atomic bomb was built, and at other nuclear sites spread so widely that former first lady Eleanor Roosevelt wrote about them to Robert Oppenheimer, the scientist who had led the bomb work. According to Michels, Oppenheimer wrote back telling her they were just rumours. Michels says the letter is verified and kept in the Library of Congress, and he tells the story to show how far the talk of UFOs over nuclear sites had travelled.
